# `/transforms` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /transforms/v1

`listTransformsV1` — List transforms

Gets a list of all saved transform objects.

- Scopes: idn:transform:manage, idn:transform:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `name` (query) — Name of the transform to retrieve from the list.
  - `filters` (query) — fields: internal: eq; name: eq, sw — e.g. `name eq "Uppercase"`
- Returns 200: array of transformread

### POST /transforms/v1

`createTransformV1` — Create transform

Creates a new transform object immediately. By default, the internal flag is set to false to indicate that this is a custom transform. Only SailPoint employees have the ability to create a transform with internal set to true. Newly created Transforms can be used in the Identity Profile mappings within the UI.

- Scopes: idn:transform:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): transform
- Returns 201: transformread

### GET /transforms/v1/{id}

`getTransformV1` — Transform by id

This API returns the transform specified by the given ID.

- Scopes: idn:transform:manage, idn:transform:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the transform to retrieve
- Returns 200: transformread

### PUT /transforms/v1/{id}

`updateTransformV1` — Update a transform

Replaces the transform specified by the given ID with the transform provided in the request body. Only the "attributes" field is mutable. Attempting to change other properties (ex. "name" and "type") will result in an error.

- Scopes: idn:transform:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the transform to update
- Body (application/json): transform
- Returns 200: transformread

### DELETE /transforms/v1/{id}

`deleteTransformV1` — Delete a transform

Deletes the transform specified by the given ID. Attempting to delete a transform that is used in one or more Identity Profile mappings will result in an error. If this occurs, you must first remove the transform from all mappings before deleting the transform.

- Scopes: idn:transform:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the transform to delete
- Returns 204: no body
